_note: Player-facing UI strings for Gamie's overnight steps (party panel, combat, inventory, title/saves). Greek copy of story/ui_text.json, same keys. Button labels aim for <=8 chars; where one language runs over, a sibling '<key>_short' exists in both files. Placeholders: {hero} {target} {monster} {item} {n} {max} {date}; names come from story/names.json. Combat/inventory log lines live in log.json. Reuse, don't duplicate: title_text.json (title buttons, slots, overwrite, saved, save_blocked, areas, language), log.json (hit, miss, monster_hit, out_of_reach, not_ready, hero_down, party_dead, drink_potion, chest_open, chest_empty, pickup_*, oil_pickup, torch_*), barks.json (tut_*).
